study: Capsule Review — fixed-update original-vs-expanded fitting-cohort CNN comparison
prior_observation_disclosure: Galar 21/23/30 source pixels and unchanged-original-CNN rankings have already been examined and are fitting-only. Exam29 source blood label counts and positive runs are known from training-pool annotation audit, but no exam29 source pixels or model scores were used to design this training schedule.
question: Does adding verified fitting images from examinations 21, 23 and 30 improve the ranking of a fixed adapted CNN on one new examination (29), compared with equally many continued-training optimizer updates on original fitting examinations 1–8 alone?

frozen_training.architecture: Existing capsule_review.baseline.AnatomyCNN(2); do not modify original 3-convolution-block structure.
frozen_training.preprocessing: Existing capsule_review.baseline.image_tensor: EXIF-orient; aspect preserving 96x96 black-padded RGB; convert to float32 in [0,1]; do not augment.
frozen_training.device: float32 CPU, deterministic PyTorch, torch threads=2
frozen_training.sampling: Uniform random example index with replacement from each arm's allowed fitting records; same fixed 666 minibatch updates for both continued-training arms. Independent seeded sampler per arm. No exam29 images during optimization.
frozen_training.loss: Cross-entropy with arm-specific inverse-frequency binary class weights, computed only on that arm's fitting images (no test-label weighting).
frozen_training.checkpoint: Exactly last update; no validation-based checkpoint selection or early stopping.

evaluation.primary: 512 frozen, source-chronological, label-blind examination-29 reference images only
evaluation.model_score: softmax of blood-positive class, not calibrated probability of diagnosis
primary_metrics: ROC-AUC and average precision for the 512 reference images
blood-positive reference image hits among exactly floor(512*budget%) selected frames at each budget
evaluation.secondary: Optional 1009-frame union including intentionally blood-enriched fitting candidates; labelled as case-mix biased and descriptive, never representative performance.
evaluation.selection_rule: No post-hoc score threshold, epoch, checkpoint, learning rate or architecture changes based on examination-29 reference labels or outcomes
evaluation.caveats: Exam29 was chosen as a fitting-pool acquisition target partly using training-cohort annotations; one examination, not confirmed independent patients; sparse-image positives are not lesions.

success_decision: Keep and report all three arms regardless of results. Do not promote an expanded model without further examination-level evaluation on genuinely reserved studies.
safety_and_storage: No raw source images, individual frame identities, labels, private model scores or fitted weights in Git. Keep private reproducibility bundle in Capsule Review Library.
intended_product_effect: Only research suggestion ranking changes after evidence; do not replace app default or claim reader-time benefit.
